core_coverage.answer_quote: Renekton is a close-range fighter/tank whose basic abilities deal physical damage, with healing and a targeted stun; Dominus adds nearby magic damage.
core_coverage.reason: Explains his role, damage types, healing and targeted stun.

core_coverage.answer_quote: His attacks build Fury that empowers abilities, giving him an AD damage focus. Slice is a damaging dash that unlocks a second dash only if it hits an enemy.
core_coverage.reason: Explains Fury empowerment and the hit condition for another dash.

issues: “Fury that empowers abilities, giving him an AD damage focus” incorrectly makes AD orientation a consequence of Fury empowerment. The supplied AD scalings support the separately typed broad orientation, not this causal connection. Separate the statements, for example: “His attacks build Fury that empowers abilities. His basic abilities have an AD damage focus.”

core_coverage.answer_quote: Basic attacks and ability hits build Fury, which decays after inactivity; Fury generation increases below half health.
core_coverage.reason: Explains generation, decay and increased generation at low health; the following exception qualifies empowered abilities.

core_coverage.answer_quote: At least 50 Fury makes the next eligible basic ability consume 50 Fury for an empowered effect. Slice is excluded from this empowerment, and empowered abilities do not generate Fury.
core_coverage.reason: Includes the threshold, expenditure, Slice exception and generation restriction.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Cull the Meek deals physical damage around Renekton and heals him for each enemy hit, with more healing against champions. Its normal version also generates Fury.
core_coverage.reason: Explains surrounding physical damage, per-target healing, champion healing and normal-version Fury generation.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Fury empowerment increases its damage and healing.
Ruthless Predator modifies Renekton's next basic attack to strike twice, dealing physical damage and briefly stunning the target.
core_coverage.reason: Explains one modified attack, its two strikes, damage and stun.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Fury empowerment makes it strike three times, deal more damage, stun longer and destroy the target's damage shields before dealing damage.
core_coverage.reason: Explains the empowered strikes, increased damage, longer stun and shield destruction in the stated champion-combat scope.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Slice dashes through enemies, dealing physical damage; hitting an enemy briefly unlocks Dice, a second dash that also deals physical damage.
core_coverage.reason: Explains both damaging dashes and the hit-gated recast.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Fury empowers Dice with additional damage and temporary armor reduction on enemies hit. Slice does not consume Fury for empowerment.
core_coverage.reason: Explains Dice's empowered effects and Slice's exclusion.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Dominus transforms Renekton into Tyrant form, granting bonus health, size and attack range, plus a larger Cull the Meek area.
core_coverage.reason: Explains the transformation and every frozen transformation benefit.

core_coverage.answer_quote: It grants Fury on activation and continually generates more during the form, up to a cap. Its aura continually deals magic damage to nearby enemies.
core_coverage.reason: Explains initial and ongoing Fury generation, its cap and nearby magic damage.

conflicts.resolution: Use the detailed passive's at-least-50 threshold and explicit Slice exception. The draft follows this resolution.
Use the detailed per-enemy healing model, increased against champions, rather than damage-proportional healing. The draft follows this resolution.
Apply the passive's explicit restriction that empowered abilities generate no Fury. The draft appropriately qualifies Q's generation.
conflicts.topic: General ability-hit Fury generation versus empowerment exception

factual_risks: The overview needs its unsupported causal link between Fury and AD orientation removed; a separate broad AD orientation is supported by the supplied scalings.
W's shield destruction is taught for champion combat. Preserve the metadata exceptions for monsters, structures and attack-trigger distinctions.
Fury generation against blind, dodge and block remains pending testing and is appropriately excluded from learning prose.
Counterplay is externally typed as source-grounded inference and follows the supplied effects without invented timings or guarantees.
No exhaustive-kit absence inference, optimal-build claim, historical mechanic, internal review label or implied human approval appears on the card faces.
